websites.title: Websites
websites.description: One per line, up to 1,000. A domain (plausible.io) or an address (https://www.kingarthurbaking.com). Each website that can be read gives one row and is charged once.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Maximum pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: How many pages of one website may be read: the homepage, the contact page, and if no role address was found yet, the legal notice or about page. More pages find a few more addresses and take longer. The price per website does not change.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Most websites answer without a proxy; some block datacenter addresses.
